---
title: "Stage 3c: NTD agency–city match roster"
---

```{r}
#| label: purpose
#| include: false
# =============================================================================
# Purpose : Build the agency-city match roster used by Stages 3d, 4, 5.
# Inputs  : data/cleaned/recalls_clean.rds
#           data/cleaned/ntd_transit.rds
#           data/raw/ntd/service_area_places_2024.csv  (FTA RY2024 served Places)
#           data/raw/census/national_place_by_county2020.txt (Place->County)
#           data/raw/census/national_cousub2020.txt (Cousub/MCD->County)
# Outputs : data/cleaned/roster_ntd.rds (city_id, ntd_id, match_via_hq,
#                                        match_via_sa_place, match_via_sa_county)
#
# Matching layers (recall city -> NTD agency):
#   HQ          : agency's HQ city/state == recall city/state (direct + JW fuzzy)
#   SA-place    : recall city listed in agency's RY2024 served-Places list
#   SA-county   : recall city's county listed in agency's RY2024 served-Counties
# A (city, agency) pair appears in the roster if ANY layer fires.
# =============================================================================
```

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(stringdist)
here::i_am("_quarto.yml")
source(here("R", "std_city.R"))

recalls <- readRDS(here("data", "cleaned", "recalls_clean.rds"))
ntd     <- readRDS(here("data", "cleaned", "ntd_transit.rds"))

cat("recalls: ", nrow(recalls), "rows,", n_distinct(recalls$city_id), "unique cities\n")
cat("NTD:    ", nrow(ntd), "rows,", n_distinct(ntd$ntd_id), "agencies\n")
```

## Standardize city names for matching

```{r}
#| label: std
recalls_key <- recalls |>
  distinct(city_id, city_std, state_std) |>
  mutate(city_std = std_city(city_std),
         state_std = str_to_lower(state_std))

# NTD: build (city_std, state_std) key from rows with city+state available
ntd_key <- ntd |>
  filter(!is.na(city), !is.na(state)) |>
  mutate(city_std = std_city(city),
         state_std = str_to_lower(state.name[match(state, state.abb)])) |>
  # state col in ntd is 2-letter abbrev; convert to full name then lower
  mutate(state_std = coalesce(state_std, str_to_lower(state)))
```

## Direct match on (city_std, state_std)

```{r}
#| label: direct-match
ntd_matched <- recalls_key |>
  inner_join(ntd_key |> distinct(city_std, state_std, ntd_id),
             by = c("city_std", "state_std"))
cat("NTD direct matches – unique recall cities:",
    n_distinct(ntd_matched$city_id), "/",
    n_distinct(recalls_key$city_id), "\n")
```

## Fuzzy match (Jaro-Winkler) for remaining recall cities

```{r}
#| label: fuzzy-match
# For each unmatched recall city, find the closest candidate within the same state.
fuzzy_find <- function(unmatched, candidates, threshold = 0.92) {
  out <- unmatched |> mutate(match_id = NA_character_, match_score = NA_real_, match_name = NA_character_)
  for (st in unique(unmatched$state_std)) {
    pool <- candidates |> filter(state_std == st)
    if (nrow(pool) == 0) next
    idx <- which(unmatched$state_std == st)
    for (i in idx) {
      scores <- 1 - stringdist::stringdist(unmatched$city_std[i], pool$city_std, method = "jw", p = 0.1)
      best <- which.max(scores)
      if (length(best) && scores[best] >= threshold) {
        out$match_id[i]    <- pool$id[best]
        out$match_score[i] <- scores[best]
        out$match_name[i]  <- pool$city_std[best]
      }
    }
  }
  out
}

# NTD fuzzy
ntd_pool <- ntd_key |> distinct(city_std, state_std, ntd_id) |> rename(id = ntd_id)
ntd_unmatched <- recalls_key |>
  anti_join(ntd_matched |> distinct(city_id), by = "city_id")
ntd_fuzzy <- fuzzy_find(ntd_unmatched, ntd_pool)
cat("NTD fuzzy hits (JW >= 0.92):", sum(!is.na(ntd_fuzzy$match_id)), "\n")

# Total matched (direct + fuzzy)
total_ntd_matched <- n_distinct(ntd_matched$city_id) + sum(!is.na(ntd_fuzzy$match_id))
cat("\n--- TOTALS ---\n")
cat("NTD:    ", total_ntd_matched, "/", n_distinct(recalls_key$city_id), "recall-active cities\n")
```

## Service-area matching (FTA Counties-and-Places, RY2024)

```{r}
#| label: sa-load
# RY2024 served-Place + served-County data. Each row = (agency, served place,
# served county) for an agency reporting demand-response (DR) mode. Agencies
# running only fixed-route modes are absent and fall back to the HQ match.
sa <- readr::read_csv(here("data", "raw", "ntd", "service_area_places_2024.csv"),
                      show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  janitor::clean_names()

# Normalize served-place names to match std_city() output
sa_norm <- sa |>
  mutate(place_norm  = std_city(place_name),
         county_norm = str_to_lower(county_name) |>
                        str_remove("\\s+county$") |> str_trim(),
         state_norm  = str_to_lower(county_state_name),
         ntd_id      = as.character(ntd_id))

cat("Service-area rows:", nrow(sa_norm), "\n")
cat("Distinct agencies in SA dataset:", n_distinct(sa_norm$ntd_id), "\n")
cat("Distinct (agency, county) pairs:", nrow(sa_norm |> distinct(ntd_id, state_norm, county_norm)), "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: place-county-xwalk
# Recall city -> county lookup. Used to test whether a recall city's county
# is listed in an agency's served-Counties.
#
# Two Census 2020 sources, combined with Place-priority + Cousub-fallback:
#   (a) Place-by-County  – covers Incorporated Places + CDPs nationwide
#   (b) Cousub-by-County – covers County Subdivisions / MCDs (townships,
#       boroughs in NJ/PA, towns in New England, charter townships in MI, etc.)
state_abb <- tibble::tibble(abb = state.abb, name = tolower(state.name)) |>
  tibble::add_row(abb = "DC", name = "district of columbia") |>
  tibble::add_row(abb = "PR", name = "puerto rico")

pc <- readr::read_delim(
  here("data", "raw", "census", "national_place_by_county2020.txt"),
  delim = "|", show_col_types = FALSE
) |> janitor::clean_names()

pc_norm <- pc |>
  dplyr::left_join(state_abb, by = c("state" = "abb")) |>
  mutate(state_full  = coalesce(name, tolower(state)),
         place_norm  = std_city(placename),
         county_norm = str_to_lower(countyname) |>
                        str_remove("\\s+county$") |> str_trim()) |>
  select(place_norm, state_norm = state_full, county_norm)

cs <- readr::read_delim(
  here("data", "raw", "census", "national_cousub2020.txt"),
  delim = "|", show_col_types = FALSE
) |> janitor::clean_names()

cs_norm <- cs |>
  dplyr::left_join(state_abb, by = c("state" = "abb")) |>
  mutate(state_full  = coalesce(name, tolower(state)),
         place_norm  = std_city(cousubname),
         county_norm = str_to_lower(countyname) |>
                        str_remove("\\s+county$") |> str_trim()) |>
  select(place_norm, state_norm = state_full, county_norm)

# Place-priority, Cousub-fallback: a recall city that resolves via the Place
# file is not looked up in the Cousub file.
ra_counties_place <- recalls_key |>
  inner_join(pc_norm,
             by = c("city_std" = "place_norm", "state_std" = "state_norm"),
             relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  distinct(city_id, state_std, county_norm)

ra_counties_cousub <- recalls_key |>
  anti_join(ra_counties_place, by = "city_id") |>
  inner_join(cs_norm,
             by = c("city_std" = "place_norm", "state_std" = "state_norm"),
             relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  distinct(city_id, state_std, county_norm)

ra_counties <- bind_rows(ra_counties_place, ra_counties_cousub) |> distinct()

cat("Recall cities with at least one county match:",
    n_distinct(ra_counties$city_id), "/", n_distinct(recalls_key$city_id),
    "  (via Place:", n_distinct(ra_counties_place$city_id),
    "; via Cousub fallback:", n_distinct(ra_counties_cousub$city_id), ")\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: build-sa-matches
# SA-place match: recall city listed in agency's served-Places (state-checked)
sa_place_matches <- recalls_key |>
  inner_join(sa_norm |> distinct(ntd_id, place_norm, state_norm),
             by = c("city_std" = "place_norm", "state_std" = "state_norm"),
             relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  distinct(city_id, ntd_id) |>
  mutate(match_via_sa_place = TRUE)

# SA-county match: recall city's county listed in agency's served-Counties
sa_county_matches <- ra_counties |>
  inner_join(sa_norm |> distinct(ntd_id, county_norm, state_norm),
             by = c("state_std" = "state_norm", "county_norm"),
             relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  distinct(city_id, ntd_id) |>
  mutate(match_via_sa_county = TRUE)

cat("SA-place (city, agency) pairs:  ", nrow(sa_place_matches), "\n")
cat("SA-county (city, agency) pairs: ", nrow(sa_county_matches), "\n")
```

## Build agency match roster (HQ ∪ SA-place ∪ SA-county)

```{r}
#| label: build-roster
# HQ matches: direct + fuzzy on agency's reported HQ city
hq_matches <- bind_rows(
  ntd_matched |> distinct(city_id, ntd_id),
  ntd_fuzzy |> filter(!is.na(match_id)) |> distinct(city_id, ntd_id = match_id)
) |> distinct() |>
  mutate(match_via_hq = TRUE)

# Union all (city, ntd_id) pairs across the three methods, then fold the flags
ntd_roster <- bind_rows(
  hq_matches |> select(city_id, ntd_id),
  sa_place_matches |> select(city_id, ntd_id),
  sa_county_matches |> select(city_id, ntd_id)
) |> distinct() |>
  left_join(hq_matches,        by = c("city_id", "ntd_id")) |>
  left_join(sa_place_matches,  by = c("city_id", "ntd_id")) |>
  left_join(sa_county_matches, by = c("city_id", "ntd_id")) |>
  mutate(across(starts_with("match_via_"), \(x) replace_na(x, FALSE))) |>
  select(city_id, ntd_id, match_via_hq, match_via_sa_place, match_via_sa_county)

saveRDS(ntd_roster, here("data", "cleaned", "roster_ntd.rds"))

cat("Wrote roster_ntd.rds:",
    nrow(ntd_roster), "(city, agency) pairs;",
    n_distinct(ntd_roster$city_id), "cities;",
    n_distinct(ntd_roster$ntd_id), "agencies\n")
cat("  via HQ:        ", sum(ntd_roster$match_via_hq), "pairs\n")
cat("  via SA-place:  ", sum(ntd_roster$match_via_sa_place), "pairs\n")
cat("  via SA-county: ", sum(ntd_roster$match_via_sa_county), "pairs\n")
```

## Coverage matrix: non-missing obs per matched city per year

```{r}
#| label: coverage
# Coverage per year: how many matched recall cities have >0 observations?
cov <- ntd |>
  inner_join(ntd_roster, by = c("ntd_id")) |>
  filter(total_capital_usd > 0) |>
  distinct(city_id, year) |>
  count(year, name = "cities_covered_ntd") |>
  arrange(year)
knitr::kable(cov, caption = "Recall-active cities with non-zero NTD transit-capital observations per year (HQ ∪ SA-place ∪ SA-county roster)")
```

## City-years available for event-study

```{r}
#| label: city-years
# Total city-years: `cov` already counts distinct cities per year, so the
# column sum is the distinct (city, year) total – no need to re-join.
ntd_city_years <- sum(cov$cities_covered_ntd)

cat(sprintf("Total NTD city-year observations w/ non-zero capital: %d  (window: %d-%d)\n",
            ntd_city_years, min(cov$year), max(cov$year)))
```
